chatgptPrompt: Create a YouTube Shorts cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Subject: a dark storm seen through a kitchen window, a thin stepped lightning path reaching down in jumps from the cloud. Composition: window centre, path top to bottom, faint branches. Lighting and treatment: storm blue, a single cool highlight; palette cream #E9E3D3, ink #1B1E24, cobalt #2F5BFF; shallow depth of field, clean exact surfaces. Mood: awe. Text: No text. Scientific accuracy: the stepped leader advances in jumps tens of meters long, about a microsecond each, with pauses of tens of microseconds; the whole descent takes tens of milliseconds. Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real news photo. Style: premium editorial science documentary, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art. Keep the focal point inside the centre safe area, clear of the bottom 25%.
